stories.title: Champions League: Lyon defeat Prague and await Fenerbahce in playoffs
stories.summary: Having lost 2-1 in the first leg, Lyon turned the tie around with a 3-0 victory over Sparta Prague in the third qualifying round of the Champions League. OL will face Fenerbahce in the playoffs to secure their place in the group stage.
